sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."MovieID") FROM "characters" AS T1 INNER JOIN "actor" AS T2 ON T1."ActorID" = T2."ActorID" WHERE T2."Gender" = 'Male' AND T2."Ethnicity" = 'African American'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM characters WHERE ActorID = (SELECT ActorID FROM actor ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(NetWorth, '$', ''), ',', '') AS REAL) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT m.Genre
FROM characters c
JOIN movie m ON m.MovieID = c.MovieID
JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID = c.ActorID
WHERE m."MPAA Rating" = 'PG'
ORDER BY CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(a.NetWorth, '$', ''), ',', '') AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT a."Height (Inches)", a."NetWorth"
FROM actor a
JOIN characters c ON a.ActorID = c.ActorID
JOIN movie m ON c.MovieID = m.MovieID
WHERE m.Title = 'Three Men and a Little Lady'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM prof WHERE gender = 'Male' AND prof_id IN (SELECT prof_id FROM RA GROUP BY prof_id HAVING COUNT(student_id) > 3)
SELECT COUNT("MovieID") FROM "movie" WHERE "MPAA Rating" = 'PG' AND "Release Date" BETWEEN '1990-06-01' AND '1990-06-30'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.NetWorth > '$400,000,000.00' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c.ActorID) FROM characters c JOIN movie m ON m.MovieID = c.MovieID JOIN actor a ON a.ActorID = c.ActorID WHERE m.Genre = 'Drama'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "course" WHERE "diff" = 5

SELECT p.first_name, p.last_name
FROM prof p
JOIN RA r ON p.prof_id = r.prof_id
GROUP BY p.prof_id
HAVING COUNT(r.student_id) > 2
ORDER BY p.teachingability DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration WHERE student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM student ORDER BY gpa DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s JOIN registration r ON s.student_id = r.student_id WHERE s.gpa BETWEEN 3 AND 4 AND (r.grade IS NULL OR r.grade = '')
SELECT T1."name" FROM "course" AS T1 INNER JOIN "registration" AS T2 ON T1."course_id" = T2."course_id" WHERE T2."sat" = 5 ORDER BY T2."sat" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student s WHERE s.type = 'UG' AND s.student_id IN (SELECT student_id FROM registration) AND s.student_id NOT IN (SELECT student_id FROM registration WHERE grade != 'A' OR grade IS NULL)

SELECT SUM(CASE r.grade WHEN 'A' THEN 4 WHEN 'B' THEN 3 WHEN 'C' THEN 2 WHEN 'D' THEN 1 END * c.credit) * 1.0 / SUM(c.credit) AS gpa
FROM registration r
JOIN course c ON c.course_id = r.course_id
WHERE r.student_id = (SELECT student_id FROM student WHERE f_name = 'Laughton' AND l_name = 'Antonio')

SELECT s.f_name, s.l_name, s.email, s.intelligence
FROM student s
JOIN RA r ON s.student_id = r.student_id
WHERE r.capability = (SELECT MAX(capability) FROM RA) AND r.salary = 'high'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN RA.salary = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(RA.salary) * 1.0 FROM RA INNER JOIN prof ON RA.prof_id = prof.prof_id WHERE prof.teachingability <= 3
SELECT name FROM course WHERE credit = (SELECT MAX(credit) FROM course) AND diff = (SELECT MAX(diff) FROM course)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registration r JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id WHERE c.name = 'Machine Learning Theory' AND r.grade = 'B' AND s.gpa > 3
SELECT AVG(T1.gpa), T1.f_name, T1.l_name FROM student AS T1 INNER JOIN RA AS T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id WHERE T2.capability = 5 AND T2.salary = 'high'

SELECT T1.f_name, T1.l_name
FROM student T1
JOIN registration T2 ON T1.student_id = T2.student_id
JOIN course T3 ON T2.course_id = T3.course_id
WHERE T3.name = 'Advanced Database Systems'
  AND T2.sat = (SELECT MAX(T4.sat)
                FROM registration T4
                JOIN course T5 ON T4.course_id = T5.course_id
                WHERE T5.name = 'Advanced Database Systems')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "student" AS T1 INNER JOIN "registration" AS T2 ON T1."student_id" = T2."student_id" INNER JOIN "course" AS T3 ON T2."course_id" = T3."course_id" WHERE T3."credit" = 3 AND T1."gpa" = 3.2

SELECT DISTINCT s.email
FROM student s
JOIN registration r ON s.student_id = r.student_id
JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id
WHERE r.grade = 'B'
  AND c.diff > (SELECT AVG(diff) * 0.8 FROM course);

SELECT (SELECT AVG(s.gpa) FROM registration r JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.diff = (SELECT MAX(diff) FROM course)) - (SELECT AVG(s.gpa) FROM registration r JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id JOIN course c ON r.course_id = c.course_id WHERE c.diff = (SELECT MIN(diff) FROM course))

SELECT c.name, s.f_name, s.l_name FROM course c JOIN registration r ON c.course_id = r.course_id JOIN student s ON r.student_id = s.student_id WHERE r.grade = 'A' AND r.course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM registration WHERE grade = 'A' GROUP BY course_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)

SELECT
  (SELECT AVG(sat) FROM registration JOIN RA ON registration.student_id = RA.student_id WHERE RA.salary = 'high')
  -
  (SELECT AVG(sat) FROM registration JOIN RA ON registration.student_id = RA.student_id WHERE RA.salary = 'free') AS diff

SELECT T1.graduate_from
FROM prof T1
JOIN RA T2 ON T1.prof_id = T2.prof_id
JOIN student T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id
WHERE T3.type = 'UG'
GROUP BY T1.prof_id
ORDER BY COUNT(T2.student_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN sat = (SELECT MAX(sat) FROM registration WHERE course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM course WHERE name = 'Intro to Database 2')) THEN student_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(student_id) AS percentage FROM registration WHERE course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM course WHERE name = 'Intro to Database 2');

SELECT T1."name" FROM "course" AS T1 INNER JOIN "registration" AS T2 ON T1."course_id" = T2."course_id" INNER JOIN "student" AS T3 ON T2."student_id" = T3."student_id" WHERE T3."type" = 'RPG' AND T2."sat" = 1
SELECT SUM(T1."votes") FROM "Vote" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Episode" AS T2 ON T1."episode_id" = T2."episode_id" WHERE T2."title" = 'Cherished' AND T1."stars" = 10
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Credit" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Episode" AS T2 ON T1."episode_id" = T2."episode_id" WHERE T2."title" = 'Cherished' AND T1."credited" = 'false'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Award AS T1 INNER JOIN Person AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id WHERE T2.name = 'Rene Balcer' AND T1.result = 'Nominee'
SELECT V.votes FROM Vote V JOIN Episode E ON V.episode_id = E.episode_id WHERE E.title = 'Sideshow' AND V.stars = 9

SELECT CAST(COUNT(T1.episode_id) AS REAL) / 9 FROM Credit AS T1 INNER JOIN Episode AS T2 ON T1.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T1.category = 'Cast' AND T1.credited = 'true' AND T2.number_in_series BETWEEN 185 AND 193
SELECT COUNT(c0) FROM (SELECT "person_id" AS c0 FROM "Award" WHERE "result" = 'Winner' GROUP BY "person_id" HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3) AS TW
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."person_id") FROM "Person" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Award" AS T2 ON T1."person_id" = T2."person_id" WHERE T1."birth_country" = 'Canada' AND T2."year" = 1999
SELECT SUM(T1."votes") FROM "Vote" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Episode" AS T2 ON T1."episode_id" = T2."episode_id" WHERE T1."stars" = 10 AND T2."rating" = (SELECT MAX("rating") FROM "Episode" LIMIT 1)
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN v.stars = 1 THEN v.votes ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(v.votes) AS percentage FROM Episode e JOIN Vote v ON e.episode_id = v.episode_id WHERE e.title = 'True North'
SELECT T1.name FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id INNER JOIN Episode AS E ON E.episode_id = T2.episode_id WHERE T2.role = 'stunt coordinator' AND E.episode = 3
SELECT T1."title" FROM "Episode" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Vote" AS T2 ON T1."episode_id" = T2."episode_id" WHERE T2."stars" = 10 AND T2."votes" >= 30 ORDER BY T2."votes" DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT p.name, CAST(COUNT(c.person_id) AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(person_id) FROM Credit) AS percentage FROM Credit c JOIN Person p ON p.person_id = c.person_id GROUP BY c.person_id ORDER BY COUNT(c.person_id) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT("episode_id") FROM "Award" WHERE "result" = 'Nominee'
SELECT "name" FROM "Person" WHERE "birth_country" = 'USA'
SELECT T1."title" FROM "Episode" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Vote" AS T2 ON T1."episode_id" = T2."episode_id" WHERE T2."stars" = 1
SELECT SUM(T1."votes") FROM "Vote" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Episode" AS T2 ON T1."episode_id" = T2."episode_id" WHERE T2."title" = 'Juvenile'

SELECT COUNT(T1."stars") FROM "Vote" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Episode" AS T2 ON T1."episode_id" = T2."episode_id" INNER JOIN "Credit" AS T3 ON T2."episode_id" = T3."episode_id" INNER JOIN "Person" AS T4 ON T3."person_id" = T4."person_id" WHERE T4."name" = 'Donna Villella'
SELECT role FROM Credit WHERE person_id = (SELECT person_id FROM Person WHERE height_meters = (SELECT MAX(height_meters) FROM Person))

SELECT CAST(SUM(v.stars) AS REAL) / COUNT(v.episode_id) AS average_star_rating FROM Vote v JOIN Credit c ON v.episode_id = c.episode_id JOIN Person p ON c.person_id = p.person_id WHERE p.name = 'Jim Bracchitta'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1."role" = 'Additional Crew' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1."episode_id") FROM "Credit" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Episode" AS T2 ON T1."episode_id" = T2."episode_id" WHERE T2."title" = 'True North'

SELECT p.name
FROM Person p
JOIN Award a ON a.person_id = p.person_id
WHERE a.organization = 'American Bar Association Silver Gavel Awards for Media and the Arts'
  AND a.award_category = 'Silver Gavel Award'
  AND a.award = 'Television'
  AND a.role = 'writer'
  AND a.result = 'Winner'
  AND a.series = 'Law and Order'
GROUP BY p.person_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.year) = 2

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Person" AS T1 INNER JOIN "Credit" AS T2 ON T1."person_id" = T2."person_id" WHERE T2."credited" = 'false' AND T2."category" = 'Cast' AND T1."birth_country" = 'USA' AND T2."episode_id" = 'tt0629228'

SELECT E.title
FROM Episode E
JOIN Vote V ON E.episode_id = V.episode_id
GROUP BY E.episode_id, E.title
ORDER BY SUM(V.stars * V.percent) / 100 DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT CAST(SUM(stars) AS REAL) / COUNT(episode_id) FROM Vote WHERE percent = (SELECT MAX(percent) FROM Vote WHERE episode_id IN (SELECT episode_id FROM Award WHERE result = 'Winner')) AND episode_id IN (SELECT episode_id FROM Award WHERE result = 'Winner')

SELECT DISTINCT T1.name FROM Person AS T1 INNER JOIN Credit AS T2 ON T1.person_id = T2.person_id INNER JOIN Award AS T3 ON T2.episode_id = T3.episode_id WHERE T1.height_meters > 1.8 AND T3.result = 'Winner'
SELECT e.episode_id FROM Episode e WHERE e.rating = 8.5 AND e.episode_id IN (SELECT a.episode_id FROM Award a WHERE a.award = 'Best Television Episode' AND a.result = 'Winner')

SELECT (SELECT VALUE FROM observations WHERE PATIENT = '71949668-1c2e-43ae-ab0a-64654608defb' AND DESCRIPTION = 'Body Weight' AND DATE LIKE '2009%') - (SELECT VALUE FROM observations WHERE PATIENT = '71949668-1c2e-43ae-ab0a-64654608defb' AND DESCRIPTION = 'Body Weight' AND DATE LIKE '2008%') AS weight_increase;

SELECT SUM(365*(CAST(strftime('%Y', m.STOP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', m.START) AS INTEGER)) + 30*(CAST(strftime('%m', m.STOP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%m', m.START) AS INTEGER)) + (CAST(strftime('%d', m.STOP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%d', m.START) AS INTEGER))) FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND m.DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Acetaminophen%'

SELECT m.DESCRIPTION
FROM medications m
JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT = p.patient
WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss'
  AND m.REASONDESCRIPTION LIKE 'Streptococcal sore throat%';

SELECT SUM(365 * (strftime('%Y', T1.STOP) - strftime('%Y', T1.START)) + 30 * (strftime('%m', T1.STOP) - strftime('%m', T1.START)) + (strftime('%d', T1.STOP) - strftime('%d', T1.START))) FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Elly' AND T2.last = 'Koss' AND T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Cystitis'
SELECT ap."PREVALENCE RATE" FROM all_prevalences ap JOIN conditions c ON ap.ITEM = c.DESCRIPTION COLLATE NOCASE WHERE c.CODE = 368581000119106 LIMIT 1

SELECT T1."DESCRIPTION" FROM "procedures" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Jacquelyn' AND T2."last" = 'Shanahan' AND T2."prefix" = 'Ms.' AND T1."DATE" = '2009-08-09'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM claims c JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Abbie' AND p.last = 'Cole' AND c.BILLABLEPERIOD BETWEEN '2010-12-31' AND '2012-01-01'

SELECT CAST(SUM(JULIANDAY(T1."STOP") - JULIANDAY(T1."START")) AS REAL) / COUNT(T1."ID") FROM "careplans" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."first" = 'Wesley' AND T2."last" = 'Lemke' AND T2."prefix" = 'Mr.'

SELECT AVG(JULIANDAY(T1.STOP) - JULIANDAY(T1.START)) FROM conditions AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Angelena' AND T2.last = 'Kertzmann' AND T2.prefix = 'Ms.' AND T1.DESCRIPTION = 'Normal pregnancy'

SELECT PATIENT FROM allergies WHERE STOP IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(STOP, -2, 1) != '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(STOP, LENGTH(STOP) - 1) AS INTEGER) + 2000 ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(STOP, LENGTH(STOP) - 1) AS INTEGER) + 1900 END) - (CASE WHEN SUBSTR(START, -2, 1) = '9' THEN CAST(SUBSTR(START, LENGTH(START) - 1) AS INTEGER) + 1900 ELSE CAST(SUBSTR(START, LENGTH(START) - 1) AS INTEGER) + 2000 END) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "conditions" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2."START") = '1988' AND T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Diabetes'
SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Height' AND VALUE = (SELECT MAX(VALUE) FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Height')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM immunizations WHERE PATIENT = (SELECT PATIENT FROM conditions WHERE DESCRIPTION = (SELECT ITEM FROM all_prevalences ORDER BY "PREVALENCE RATE" DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY START DESC LIMIT 1)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PATIENT) FROM conditions WHERE UPPER(DESCRIPTION) = UPPER((SELECT ITEM FROM all_prevalences ORDER BY "PREVALENCE RATE" DESC LIMIT 1))

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.PATIENT) FROM conditions c JOIN immunizations i ON c.PATIENT = i.PATIENT WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'meningococcal MCV4P' AND c.START > i.DATE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "conditions" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Prediabetes' AND T1."gender" = 'F'
SELECT PATIENT FROM careplans WHERE CODE = 311791003

SELECT DISTINCT p.ssn
FROM patients p
JOIN conditions c ON c.PATIENT = p.patient
JOIN all_prevalences ap ON ap.ITEM = c.DESCRIPTION
WHERE ap."PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE" < 0.3 * (SELECT AVG("PREVALENCE PERCENTAGE") FROM all_prevalences)
LIMIT 5

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'F' AND T1.race = 'asian' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.patient) AS percentage FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN conditions AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Acute bronchitis (disorder)'
SELECT T1."patient" FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "allergies" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Allergy to soya'

SELECT p.first, p.last,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', o.DATE) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthdate) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM observations o
JOIN patients p ON o.PATIENT = p.patient
WHERE o.DATE LIKE '2011%'
  AND o.DESCRIPTION = 'Systolic Blood Pressure'
  AND o.VALUE = 200
  AND o.UNITS = 'mmHg';
SELECT T1."address" FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "claims" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2."BILLABLEPERIOD") = '2010'
SELECT a.START FROM allergies a JOIN patients p ON a.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Angelo' AND p.last = 'Buckridge'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "allergies" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'House dust mite allergy' AND T1."gender" = 'M'
SELECT (SUM(T1.deathdate) - SUM(T2.birthdate)) / COUNT(T2.patient) FROM careplans AS T1 JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Prediabetes'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "procedures" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Bone immobilization' AND T1."drivers" IS NOT NULL
SELECT p.first, p.last FROM patients p JOIN allergies a ON p.patient = a.PATIENT GROUP BY p.patient HAVING COUNT(a.DESCRIPTION) > 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "allergies" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" INNER JOIN "immunizations" AS T3 ON T1."patient" = T3."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Allergy to eggs' AND T3."DESCRIPTION" = 'Td (adult) preservative free'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.PATIENT) FROM observations o JOIN careplans c ON o.PATIENT = c.PATIENT WHERE o.DESCRIPTION = 'Body Weight' AND o.VALUE > 100 AND o.UNITS = 'kg' AND c.DESCRIPTION = 'Diabetes self management plan'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.PATIENT) FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON p.patient = m.PATIENT WHERE p.ethnicity = 'irish' AND m.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Myocardial Infarction'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT i.PATIENT) FROM immunizations i JOIN careplans c ON i.PATIENT = c.PATIENT WHERE i.DESCRIPTION = 'rotavirus  monovalent' AND c.STOP = '2013-11-23';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "medications" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Nitroglycerin 0.4 MG/ACTUAT [Nitrolingual]' AND T1."gender" = 'F'

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.DESCRIPTION = 'Allergy to grass pollen' THEN p.patient END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT p.patient) AS percentage FROM patients p LEFT JOIN allergies a ON p.patient = a.PATIENT WHERE p.birthplace = 'Pembroke MA US'

SELECT allergies.STOP - allergies.START, allergies.DESCRIPTION FROM allergies WHERE allergies.PATIENT = (SELECT patients.patient FROM patients WHERE patients.first = 'Isadora' AND patients.last = 'Moen')
SELECT DISTINCT p.first, p.last FROM patients p JOIN careplans c ON p.patient = c.PATIENT WHERE p.marital = 'M' AND strftime('%Y', c.START) = '2009' AND julianday(c.STOP) - julianday(c.START) > 60

SELECT DISTINCT i.DATE FROM immunizations i JOIN patients p ON i.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE p.first = 'Elly' AND p.last = 'Koss' AND i.DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' ORDER BY i.DATE

SELECT COUNT(T1.patient) FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN immunizations AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DATE BETWEEN '2010-07-09' AND '2013-10-29' AND T2.DESCRIPTION = 'meningococcal MCV4P' AND T1.race = 'black'

SELECT CODE, DATE FROM immunizations WHERE PATIENT = (SELECT patient FROM patients WHERE first = 'Jacquelyn' AND last = 'Shanahan' AND prefix = 'Ms.') AND DESCRIPTION = 'Influenza  seasonal  injectable  preservative free' ORDER BY DATE

SELECT JULIANDAY(m.STOP) - JULIANDAY(m.START) AS days
FROM medications m
JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT = p.patient
JOIN encounters e ON m.ENCOUNTER = e.ID
WHERE p.first = 'Berry' AND p.last = 'Keebler'
  AND m.DESCRIPTION = 'Acetaminophen 160 MG'
  AND m.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Acute bronchitis (disorder)'
ORDER BY e.DATE
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.ssn, p.address
FROM patients p
JOIN encounters e ON p.patient = e.PATIENT
WHERE e.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Viral sinusitis (disorder)'
  AND e.DATE = '2008-06-13';

SELECT m.REASONDESCRIPTION, m.DESCRIPTION, julianday(m.STOP) - julianday(m.START) AS duration, CASE WHEN p.deathdate IS NULL THEN 'alive' ELSE 'not alive' END AS alive_status FROM medications m JOIN patients p ON m.PATIENT = p.patient WHERE m.ENCOUNTER = '23c293ec-dbae-4a22-896e-f12cf3c8bac3'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.first, T1.last FROM patients AS T1 INNER JOIN allergies AS T2 ON T1.patient = T2.PATIENT WHERE T2.DESCRIPTION = 'Shellfish allergy' AND (julianday(T1.deathdate) - julianday(T1.birthdate)) / 365 < 12

SELECT SUM(julianday(medications.STOP) - julianday(medications.START)) FROM medications JOIN patients ON patients.patient = medications.PATIENT WHERE patients.first = 'Major' AND patients.last = 'D''Amore' AND patients.prefix = 'Mr.' AND medications.DESCRIPTION = ' Amoxicillin 250 MG / Clavulanate 125 MG [Augmentin]'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.DESCRIPTION) FROM medications m JOIN encounters e ON m.ENCOUNTER = e.ID WHERE e.PATIENT = (SELECT patient FROM patients WHERE first = 'Major' AND last = 'D''Amore') AND e.DESCRIPTION = 'Hospital admission'
SELECT T1."DESCRIPTION", T1."VALUE", T1."UNITS" FROM "observations" AS T1 INNER JOIN "patients" AS T2 ON T1."PATIENT" = T2."patient" WHERE T2."last" = 'Rolfson' AND T2."first" = 'Bella'

SELECT c.DESCRIPTION
FROM conditions c
WHERE c.PATIENT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT PATIENT FROM observations
    WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Mass Index' AND VALUE < 18.5
)
GROUP BY c.DESCRIPTION
ORDER BY COUNT(c.DESCRIPTION) DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT DISTINCT careplans.DESCRIPTION FROM careplans INNER JOIN patients ON careplans.PATIENT = patients.patient WHERE patients.prefix = 'Mrs.' AND patients.first = 'Elly' AND patients.last = 'Koss' AND substr(careplans.START, 1, 4) = '1970' AND substr(careplans.STOP, 1, 4) = '1970'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1."patient") FROM "patients" AS T1 INNER JOIN "conditions" AS T2 ON T1."patient" = T2."PATIENT" WHERE T2."DESCRIPTION" = 'Normal pregnancy' AND T1."gender" = 'F' AND T1."marital" = 'S'

SELECT DISTINCT T1.DESCRIPTION, T2.DESCRIPTION FROM procedures AS T1 JOIN medications AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.PATIENT JOIN encounters AS T3 ON T1.PATIENT = T3.PATIENT WHERE T3.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Drug overdose'

SELECT SUM(VALUE) / COUNT(PATIENT) AS avg_bmi FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Body Mass Index' AND PATIENT IN (SELECT PATIENT FROM observations WHERE DESCRIPTION = 'Total Cholesterol' AND VALUE >= 200);

SELECT ROUND(
  CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', c.START) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.birthdate) AS INTEGER) > 60 THEN c.PATIENT END) AS REAL) * 100
  / COUNT(DISTINCT c.PATIENT), 2) AS percentage
FROM conditions c
JOIN patients p ON c.PATIENT = p.patient
WHERE c.DESCRIPTION = (
  SELECT c2.DESCRIPTION FROM conditions c2
  GROUP BY c2.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY COUNT(c2.DESCRIPTION) DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT MIN(T1.DATE) - T2.birthdate FROM encounters AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Stacy' AND T2.last = 'Morar' AND T1.REASONDESCRIPTION = 'Drug overdose'
SELECT CAST(COUNT("PATIENT") AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT SUBSTRING("DATE", 1, 4)) FROM "procedures" WHERE "DESCRIPTION" = 'Combined chemotherapy and radiation therapy (procedure)'
SELECT T1.START - T1.STOP, T1.DESCRIPTION FROM allergies AS T1 INNER JOIN patients AS T2 ON T1.PATIENT = T2.patient WHERE T2.first = 'Isadora' AND T2.last = 'Moen'

SELECT MIN(encounters.DATE) - patients.birthdate AS age
FROM patients INNER JOIN encounters ON patients.patient = encounters.PATIENT

SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(CASE WHEN ng IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_given
FROM (
  SELECT T1.playerID AS pid, T2.year AS y, T2.tmID AS tm, T1.nameGiven AS ng, T1.lastName AS ln, SUM(T2.G) AS tg
  FROM Master AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.playerID = T2.playerID
  WHERE T1.birthCountry = 'Canada'
    AND CAST(T1.firstNHL AS INTEGER) - CAST(T1.birthYear AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 18 AND 24
  GROUP BY T1.playerID, T2.year, T2.tmID
  HAVING SUM(T2.G) <= 5 AND ng IS NOT NULL
)
